scope: Reject out-of-domain explicit HATCH gradient-stop RGB and ACI values before parser mutation, and enforce the same scalar bounds in HATCH typed-model validation.

sourceWitness.parser: DRW_Hatch::parseCode currently stores group 421 into GradientStop::rgb and group 63 into GradientStop::aciColor without checking the explicit value domains.
sourceWitness.readerCompletion: processHatch calls DRW_Hatch::validateDxf before publishing the callback, but validateDxf currently does not validate gradient-stop color scalar ranges.
sourceWitness.writerControl: dxfRW::validateHatchPayload already bounds stop.rgb to 0..0xFFFFFF and stop.aciColor to 0..256, so this closes the reader/model admission mismatch without changing writer behavior.
sourceWitness.autodeskTrueColorDefinition: Autodesk's common DXF color group documentation describes true color as a 24-bit value, with each RGB byte 0..255 and a zero top byte.
sourceWitness.autodeskAciDefinition: Autodesk AcCmColor::setColorIndex accepts 0..256, with 0 BYBLOCK, 256 BYLAYER and 1..255 indexed ACI colors.

implementationBrief.rgbRule: Explicit gradient group 421 values must be in 0..0xFFFFFF; the absent sentinel -1 remains a model-only state and is not accepted as an explicit group value.
implementationBrief.aciRule: Gradient group 63 values must be in 0..256, including the documented BYBLOCK/BYLAYER endpoint indices.
implementationBrief.stateRule: Check each local parsed scalar before assigning it; corrected values for the same group must be retryable. Validate the stop color scalar ranges before callback publication.
implementationBrief.tests: Generated parser selector covers negative/over-range values, valid endpoints, state preservation and corrected same-group retry for RGB and ACI stops.
implementationBrief.doNotInfer: These scalar checks do not qualify HATCH gradient rendering, producer breadth or native semantic support.

validationPlan: Run the owning selector and affected HATCH/MPOLYGON gradient cohort.
Run git diff --check; do not add DWG/DXF sample fixtures.

verifiedBehavior: HATCH group 421 rejects negative and over-24-bit explicit RGB values before changing the current gradient stop; same-group retry with 0xFFFFFF succeeds.
HATCH group 421 accepts RGB endpoints 0 and 0xFFFFFF.
HATCH gradient group 63 rejects negative and greater-than-256 indices before mutation; corrected same-group retry with 256 succeeds.
Typed-model validation rejects out-of-range RGB and ACI scalars on otherwise valid two-stop gradients.

fixtures.testInput: Generated in-memory DXF group records; no sample files.
